controls.title: Connector release authority
controls.claim: A connector release authority is append-only, tenant-isolated and current-state resolved.
controls.reason: The writer, PostgresReleaseAuthorityAdminStore.Append, is in scripts/ci/deadcode-allowlist.txt, so no shipped path records a release authority for the reader to enforce.
protected_operations: Recording and resolving connector release authorities.
bypass_assumptions: No shipped writer exists.

controls.title: Guardian governance options not installed
controls.claim: The Guardian enforces capability registry entries, task capability tokens, rollback plans, session risk memory and privilege resolution.
controls.reason: The capability registry, task capability tokens, rollback plans, session risk memory and privilege resolver are Guardian options that no shipped binary installs: each With* option is in scripts/ci/deadcode-allowlist.txt.
protected_operations: Guardian evaluations, if these options were installed.
bypass_assumptions: None of these options is set in serve, proxy or mcp serve.

controls.title: Unwired adapters
controls.claim: Browser-split interception, Sentinel webhooks, Vaultak state reversibility and AIP delegation verification govern their actions.
controls.reason: BrowserSplitAdapter, SentinelConnector, VaultakStateBridge and AIPVerifier are libraries that no shipped binary mounts or calls; their methods are in scripts/ci/deadcode-allowlist.txt.
protected_operations: The actions these adapters would govern.
bypass_assumptions: No shipped caller exists.

controls.title: WASI sandbox containment
controls.claim: The WASI sandbox denies all filesystem and network I/O unless explicitly granted.
controls.reason: The shipped server refuses every WASI pack run because it has no PackVerifier, and WASISandbox.Run and SandboxBroker.Execute are in scripts/ci/deadcode-allowlist.txt. Sandbox grants and preflight are records only.
protected_operations: Running a pack in the WASI sandbox.
bypass_assumptions: No shipped path runs a pack.

controls.title: Connector contract pinning
controls.claim: A connector response whose schema drifts from its pin is denied with ERR_CONNECTOR_CONTRACT_DRIFT.
controls.reason: ValidateAndCanonicalizeToolOutput is in scripts/ci/deadcode-allowlist.txt, and the preview TON Acton connector that also reports drift is not linked into core/cmd/helm-ai-kernel.
protected_operations: Connector responses.
bypass_assumptions: No shipped caller exists.

controls.title: Kernel credentials never reach the model provider
controls.claim: POST /v1/chat/completions on serve never forwards the admin, service or organization-runtime key to the model provider; only a caller's provider key reaches it (R8).
config: HELM_ADMIN_API_KEY, HELM_SERVICE_API_KEY and HELM_ORGANIZATION_RUNTIME_API_KEY, the values that are dropped
protected_operations: The Authorization header that api.HandleOpenAIProxy forwards upstream as the provider credential.
bypass_assumptions: Only exact kernel keys are recognised, with or without an auth scheme; a value derived from a key is not.
The Control Plane token path drops its token separately (control_plane_token.go).
The standalone `helm-ai-kernel proxy` forwards the caller's Authorization; it holds no kernel credential to leak.
